# Welcome to the frcp.net repository

Both developers and users are encouraged to contribute whether it's a pull request, bug report or a feature request.

## Before opening an issue
- Keep it one issue per issue
- Don't make it longer than it needs to be
- It's okay to use AI, as long as you read it yourself and you still follow the points above

## Before submitting a pull request
- Keep an eye out for any conflicts with current main and any other open PRs
- Manually test on local live server that everything still works
